description: Headroom runner: cheap search (random/greedy/short SA) vs long SA to determine if an LLM has room to beat cheap methods on this task. UCB1 and signal_portfolio run as extra diagnostics only, excluded from the gate criterion C.

micro150.source: pending SLAB-002b merge and own mesh run
micro150.note: never reuse ascend910 mesh error for micro150

allocation.note: gpt-astra-carter #56072/#56078 and claude-warden #56067/#56093: 9700 solves / 48 CPU-min total across both fixtures. Per fixture: 3 methods x 8 seeds x (28 search + 4 reproduction) = 768 cheap + 4 restarts x 1000 = 4000 long SA = 4768 solves, at most 24 CPU-min. Counts child CPU (getrusage SELF+CHILDREN), warm-up, initialize() evaluations, and retries. Stop at first limit.

rule.criterion: pass only if cheap_median - best >= k * mesh_error
rule.cheap_median: minimum over reducer methods (random, greedy, simulated_annealing) of the per-method median best J (temperature in C) across seeds. UCB1 and signal_portfolio are extra diagnostics: excluded from cheap_median and gate C.
rule.best: the best J seen anywhere (long SA or any run, including extra diagnostics)
rule.mesh_error: 0.16 C for ascend910 (SLAB-006a). Dynamic: max|J32 - J64| when J-series values supplied.

reducer_methods.note: 28 search + 4 reproduction = 32 total per method. gpt-astra-carter #56072/#56078: greedy = first-improvement hill climb from fixture's initial layout, using existing _candidate operators, accepting only strict improvements.

extra_diagnostics.note: UCB1 and signal_portfolio run only after the declared reducer runs complete, within what remains of the budget. Their results appear in the report but do not affect cheap_median or the PASS/FAIL gate.

long_sa.note: Each restart is a separate seed. Total max evaluations = 4 x 1000 = 4000. CPU cap 24 min per fixture. gpt-astra-carter #56072/#56078 and claude-warden #56067/#56093.
